item.title: Cooking
item.description: Cooking at home: recipes, ingredients and ways to cook.

children.definition: a set of instructions that tells you how to cook a dish
children.example: My grandmother never uses a recipe when she makes plov.

children.definition: one of the foods you use to make a dish
children.example: Rice, carrots, onions and meat are the main ingredients of plov.

children.definition: to cook something in very hot water
children.example: Boil the potatoes for twenty minutes.

children.definition: to cook something in hot oil
children.example: She fried the onions until they were golden.

children.definition: to cook bread or cakes in an oven
children.example: We baked a cake for Dad's birthday.

children.definition: to cut something into small pieces with a knife
children.example: Chop the carrots into long thin pieces.

children.definition: a deep round container for cooking
children.example: Plov is cooked in a big heavy pot called a kazan.

children.definition: the part of a cooker with a door, where you bake or roast food
children.example: Put the bread in the oven for thirty minutes.

children.definition: to try a little food to find out what it is like
children.example: Taste the soup. Does it need more salt?

children.definition: having a strong hot taste from pepper or chilli
children.example: This sauce is too spicy for me.

children.definition: recently made, picked or bought; not old
children.example: We buy fresh bread every morning.
